[quote=saarland_et_nord_de_la_france;58218417]Meme time[/quote]
Welcome

[spoiler=Operation "Two Mines"]

OPERATION TWO MINES
DATE: XX/XX/XXXX
OPERATION STATUS: ALL GOALS COMPLETED
COMPANIES INVOLVED: [DATA CLASSIFIED]
DEAD OR WOUNDED: 83 LA TROOPS
----------------------------------------------------------------
 OBJECT OF INTEREST: RECORDED MEETING BETWEEN MAJOR GENERAL JUAN BUTTLER AND FORWARD COMMANDER IVY MESANA, VETTED BY SEGER INTELLIGENCE COMMAND
----------------------------------------------------------------
START OF RECORDING:
M.G. Juan Buttler walks into the office, sitting down in the chair forward of the desk as F.C. Ivy Mesana types on her computer.
Ivy: Sorry sir, I know this was scheduled but I didnt expect the intelligence guys to need me to sign off on so many things, and I can never get used to doing it electronically.
Juan: It's fine commander. We have bureaucracy for a reason after all
Ivy: Okay, there it is. I assume you're here to see how everything is so far?
Juan: Well yes, and the runway incident of course.
Ivy: Yah, I suspected that. To get right to the point though, its been going well, other than the crash. Thankfully everything else is running smoothly so it hasnt been too hard to get those contractors out here and start work on extraction operations. The aluminum will help us at least.
Juan: Good to hear theyre getting work done already. Government didnt give them subsidies for nothing. Anyhow,wanna inform me on what happened to that transport?
Ivy: Okay, so the engineers finally got a report for me yesterday. Apparently there was a small sinkhole that somehow didnt collapse during construction, and the weight of the transport landing made it collapse. Long story short, landing gear ripped off, plane slid and collided into an under service plane, making both engulfed once the fuel finally ignited.
Juan: And I suspect they checked the base for any more sinkholes, yes?
Ivy: Yes, they are doing it currently.
Juan: Good. Are the northern troops doing well? Same progress as here?
Ivy: "Affirmative. The army engineers are working on a railway and port to help move along the lithium and coal, and the gas company we got onboard with this is beginning preparations for starting construction of that pipeline.
Juan: Good then! Now, would you like to offer me a tour of the base?
Ivy: "Of course, Ill show you the new mine as well.
END OF RECORDING
----------------------------------------------------------------
INCIDENT REPORT #1409
OFFICER FILING REPORT: BAUER ANCRUM
INCIDENT LOCATION: Camden Army Airbase
INCIDENT CAUSE: Collapse of ground under landing aircraft
CASUALTIES OR LOST EQUIPMENT:
77 LA casualties (73 dead, 4 injured)
One LRLA-89 Lira aircraft
One TA-5 Shrike aircraft
INCIDENT RESPONSE: Firefighter brigade deployed, medics moved wounded and bodies, wreck moved and under process of dismantling. Base investigated for other potential sinkholes.

[/spoiler]
